ns2:section.sectionText: Live optional zoom sessions will be held each Wednesday for additional support for students. Two evening midterm exams will administered online on selected Wednesdays from 7:00 - 8:20pm. Instructor will give exact dates and times at the start of the term. ALL ACCY 201 SECTIONS RESTRICTED TO SPECIFIED MAJORS. ALL OTHERS MAY ENROLL MONDAY, DECEMBER14, 2020 AT 10:00AM IF SPACE IS AVAILABLE Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
